_meta.openai/widgetDescription: A list of the shop's voucher codes and offers with copy buttons, end dates and links.

annotations.title: Search UK voucher codes by shop

description: Live voucher codes and offers PriceDash lists for one UK shop or brand, up to five, with each code, end date, the day it was last checked at source, and a PriceDash link to the offer. Offers checked in the last 30 days come first.

companyName.description: The shop or brand name, e.g. 'Currys', 'Boots', 'ASOS'

name: search-vouchers

hasMore.description: True when the page has more offers than are listed

checkedDate.description: The day PriceDash last read the offer at source, when within the last 30 days

code.description: The voucher code to enter at checkout, when the offer has one

expiryDate.description: When the offer ends, if it has an end date

linkUrl.description: PriceDash's link to the offer at the shop

siteUrl.description: The PriceDash page with every offer

suggestions.description: Shop or category names to try when nothing matched

title.description: The shop, or the list, the offers are for

title: Search UK voucher codes by shop
